India Minister Addresses Student Protest After Violence

India's Minister for Education broke his silence on a student protest that turned violent, stating that the government would not tolerate "anti-national" activities. The protest, which began peacefully, saw clashes between students and police. The minister's statement came after several days of demonstrations. The government has initiated an inquiry into the violence.
